question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'a'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given blank needs an article to refer to the second man who is unknown.
 
• The correct article in such a case is the indefinite article a as a *man *begins with the consonant **m.**
 
• Hence, option 4 or a is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.

Correct passage__ - *Once, a man and his son were going into town. (1) __they__ wanted to sell some potatoes. They went with (2) __their__ donkey, and the donkey (3) __carried__ the potatoes. While they walked, (4)__ a__ man came past on a horse.*

*"Shame (5) __on__ you!" he said. "Why do you have a donkey, but you don't ride it?"*
